DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

Based on your 3-minute episode triggered by head movement (going to bed), lack of hearing loss, and current return to baseline, these are classic features of BPPV. The medical image request for the MRI was a precaution, but the clinical picture strongly points to a vestibular canalolithiasis rather than a central cause.
